datasets.name: ScheduleData
datasets.sql:
SELECT Z.RowID,Z.*
  FROM CM_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE Z
WHERE Z.CREDITID=:CREDITID
ORDER BY PAYMENTDATE

datasets.name: BoorowerInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   bi.NAME,
   cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.booroweraccid) as custaccno,
   cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(a.Loanaccid) as loanaccno  
FROM
  CM_BOOROWERINFO bi, cm_accounts a
WHERE bi.CreditID=:CREDITID
and a.creditid = :CREDITID

datasets.name: CreditInfo
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   A.ID , A.CURRENCY , A.CREDITLINEAMOUNT , A.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE , A.DATEOFCONCLUSION,a.annualbankrate,a.annualypenaltyrate,a.intcalcmethod
 , A.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT , nvl(a.duedatelastcontract,DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT) enddat,
   A.CREDITTYPE,a.branchid,
   cm_common.GetPeriod(A.DATEOFCONCLUSION,A.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT) as period,v.val_name,
   c.rest+c.duerest rest
FROM
   CM_portfolio A,avalute v,
   cm_curr_state c
WHERE a.ID=:ID
and c.creditid = :ID
and a.currency=v.valute

datasets.name: ExportData
datasets.sql:
SELECT  paymentdate, principal, interest,rest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule
where Creditid=:CREDITID
ORDER BY PAYMENTDATE

datasets.name: FilialInfo

select id,name from filial

datasets.name: AboutContractDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT V.VAL_NAME as CURRENCY
     , C.NAME as CUSTNAME
     , P.CREDITLINEAMOUNT as AMOUNT
  FROM CM_portfolio P
      ,CM_BOOROWERINFO C
      ,AVALUTE V
 WHERE P.ID = C.CREDITID
   AND P.CURRENCY = V.VALUTE
   AND ID = :ID

datasets.name: TrancheScheduleDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT T.RowID, T.*
  FROM CM_TRANCHE_SCHEDULE T
 WHERE T.CREDITID = :CREDITID
